name: Family Residence Permit (Aile İkamet İzni)

requirements.blocker_text: This covers foreign spouses and foreign/minor/dependent children of Turkish citizens, foreign residents holding a permit, refugees, and subsidiary-protection beneficiaries.

value.note: no fixed EUR/USD figure — sponsor must show health insurance, no conviction for crimes against the family in the preceding 5 years, and at least 1 year of prior residence in Turkey on a permit (waived where the sponsor is a Turkish citizen)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires the sponsor to hold health insurance covering all family members, have no conviction for crimes against the family in the preceding 5 years, and — unless the sponsor is a Turkish citizen — have at least 1 year of prior residence in Turkey on a permit.

outcome.duration_length: up to 3 years at a time, never exceeding the sponsor's own permit duration

sources.title: Residence Permit Types - Presidency of Migration Management

notes: Children may attend primary/secondary school to age 18 WITHOUT needing a separate student permit — a genuine, real simplification worth surfacing distinctly, since most family routes in this dataset require dependants to obtain their own status for education access. Adults on a family permit CANNOT work without a separate work permit — work_rights marked 'none' rather than 'restricted' to reflect this hard gate accurately. Switches to a short-term permit after 3 years on this route (or on divorce/domestic-violence exception, sponsor's death, or a child turning 18) — a genuinely built-in transition mechanic worth flagging. Time on this route counts toward BOTH the 8-year long-term residence clock AND the 5-year independent ordinary-naturalisation clock — Turkey's dual-clock structure (see tr_short_term_residence's notes) applies identically here.
